drawing_surface.finding: Add corner places a corner at the CURRENT map centre: repeated clicks at the same centre do not advance the count past 1 (the second same-position corner is deduplicated). A ring needs the viewport centre moved between clicks (pan or address re-centre) - the controller tests' click-at-distinct-points semantics map to pan-then-add in the browser

results: Add corner button x4 without moving the centre: counter stays 1 (same-position dedup)
mouse drag on the canvas then Add corner x4: counter stays 1 - the drag did not move the map centre during drawing mode (Terra Draw's drag handler likely consumes or suppresses the map pan)
direct canvas clicks at 4 distinct positions: counter stays 0 - the canvas click does not reach Terra Draw's ring mode (it binds to the map container's own events, not the raw canvas element)

source_study.map_options: MapViewport constructs MapLibreMap with cooperativeGestures: true - plain drags do NOT pan (page-friendly); pan requires Ctrl+drag. This explains why the plain-drag probe moved nothing
source_study.click_to_add: the collector binds map.on('click'): one physical release = at most one point (event.originalEvent.detail>1 rejected), gated on a completed single-pointer gesture ON the canvas (MapPrefixController.down). So the real-user path is plain map clicks - no button needed
source_study.reticle: .lp-map-reticle is 24px at centre with pointer-events:none - it does not intercept
source_study.remaining_unknown: direct canvas clicks at 40%/60% boundingBox positions still left the counter at 0 - most likely the #lp-design scroll container clips the canvas so part of the bounding box is off-viewport and the clicks landed outside the visible map; next pass: scrollIntoView the canvas, click its VISIBLE centre, verify with a screenshot that the click lands on map pixels

attempted_extra: keyboard arrow pan (focus canvas + 5x arrows): counter stays 1 - cooperativeGestures also gates keyboard pan
Ctrl+drag pan: counter still 1 - the prefix controller's pointerdown capture likely consumes the gesture before maplibre pans during collecting mode
